decision: single source: POST /v2/uncertainty/compare (+ cheap availability gate). One bundle per anchor serves every driver; driver switching is local.
why_not_consensus_compare: overlapping U1 field data would cost a second request; consensus page remains the expert deep-dive (linked). No data needed by the A-contract is missing from the uncertainty bundle.

anchor.anchor_lap_number: frame.frame.anchor_lap_number (the frame's own exact state identity)
anchor.anchor_state_time_s: frame.frame.anchor_state_time_s (exact; availability granularity is lap-level, verified: lap2 t=100 still COMPARABLE)

sparsity_finding: comparability is sparse and frozen: 2022-r03-R has exactly 1 comparable lap of 57 (lap 2); sampled laps of 2024-r21-R none. Refusal UI is therefore the common case — honest frozen reality (checkpoints sparse, MC2 38%). No snapping to nearby comparable anchors (forbidden).
live_probe: 2022-r03-R lap2 t=3912.405 → 20 AVAILABLE drivers; e.g. hamilton MODEL 0.561 vs SIM 0.048 (large frozen disagreement, ideal demo)
